<img src=x onerror=alert(1)> Hostile page

This paragraph is long enough to make the page readable, and it carries a script link that the reader must never keep, together with a disguised one.

The second paragraph adds more words so that the article clears the minimum length, and it mentions <script>alert("text")</script> as plain text that must be escaped.

A third paragraph adds an image whose source is a script URL, which the reader drops, and a picture that tries to break out of its attribute with quotes.

The final paragraph closes the article with a sentence or two more, because the reader wants a reasonable amount of text before it offers itself to the person.
